title: BG Group Plc - proposed acquisition of Queensland Gas Company (QGC)

body_sections.Summary: BG Group Plc (BG Group) through its subsidiaries proposes to acquire approximately 10% of the shares in the capital of Queensland Gas Company (QGC) and certain assets (being interests in gas exploration and production joint ventures).  BG Group and QGC also propose to form a joint venture for the marketing and sale of gas produced by each of the companies.
body_sections.Market definition: The ACCC did not consider it necessary to form a view in relation to market definition.
body_sections.Competition analysis: The ACCC considered that the transaction was unlikely to result in a substantial lessening of competition, as BG Group does not currently have operations in Australia.
